section: Fixes and new things
roadmap: Recovery after an unclean exit: Restore works, one question per crashed session, failures shown and the copy kept
---
- Restoring work after the editor closed unexpectedly works: one question
  per lost session, scripts come back as scripts, and if something cannot
  be restored the window says why and keeps the copy. A new Keep for later
  button leaves the copy for another time.
